# Korec--Znam finite-quotient record

Source: Ivan Korec and Stefan Znam, *On disjoint covering of groups by their
cosets*, Mathematica Slovaca 27 (1977), no. 1, 3--7.

Persistent record: https://dml.cz/dmlcz/129020

Reviewed: 2026-08-03 JST (UTC+09:00).

The paper states that the study of finite disjoint coset coverings can be
reduced to finite groups. The public manuscript also gives the standard direct
construction: intersect the normal cores of the finitely many finite-index
subgroups, then pass to the resulting finite quotient. The quotient preserves
the cells and their indices.

This source is used only for context and confirmation of the finite-reduction
step. The local Lean development does not formalize the quotient construction.
